# Collector test fixtures

Generated by `go run ./cmd/sflow-gen -write-fixtures tests/fixtures`. Synthetic data only.

- `ipv4_tcp_https_vlan.bin` (220 bytes): IPv4 TCP/443, 802.1Q VLAN 120 in header, ifIndex 24 -> 48
- `ipv4_udp_dns_extswitch.bin` (204 bytes): IPv4 UDP/53, untagged header, VLAN 20 from extended switch record
- `ipv6_udp.bin` (220 bytes): IPv6 UDP/443 (QUIC-like), VLAN 30
- `multi_sample.bin` (704 bytes): 3 flow samples + 1 counter sample in one datagram
- `expanded_flow.bin` (232 bytes): expanded flow sample (format 3), ifIndex 1001 -> 2002
- `counters_only.bin` (144 bytes): counter sample with generic interface counters
- `unknown_sample_and_record.bin` (244 bytes): unknown sample format 99 and unknown flow record 4242 next to a valid flow
- `malformed_truncated.bin` (352 bytes): multi_sample cut in the middle of the second sample
- `unsupported_version.bin` (28 bytes): sFlow v4 header
- `two_exporters.pcap`: 20 datagrams from agents 10.255.0.1 and 10.255.0.2 (classic pcap)
